gen-dafont-stencilia-bitter: Bitter is a slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye and an s you can see straight through. Bitter holds up over a full page of text, dependable and grounded beneath Stencilia's striking display letters.
gen-dafont-stencilia-fs-bespoke-sans: Stencilia's spacious gaps at the curve ends give the display heading a structural, cut-out look, while Bespoke Sans stays sharp and refined below. Its lowercase sits moderate in height.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-fauna-one: Structural meets literary. Stencilia is at its best making a striking statement, whereas Fauna One, a classic serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, is built for dignified reading.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-glegoo: Striking and structural up top, then a refined, editorial turn below: Stencilia leads, and Glegoo follows in a classic serif with big counters and wide, unclosed curves. They hand off smoothly.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-kadwa: Bold structure meets old-school polish here. Stencilia does its best work as a striking display heading, and Kadwa, a text serif with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, handles the editorial reading.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noticia-text: Stencilia brings structural, striking display letters with spacious gaps at the curve terminals, over Noticia Text, a text serif whose lowercase fills most of the letter height. Dignified and literary below, bold above.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-piazzolla: Stencilia's compact gap between x-height and ascender line gives its display letters a structural, striking look. Piazzolla, a classic serif with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, brings refined authority.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-pridi: Pridi reads classic and refined, its small letters standing almost capital-sized. Stencilia sits above it as a structural display heading, and the two make a sturdy, handsome page.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-scope-one: Stencilia's spacious gaps at its curve terminals make the display heading structural and striking, while Scope One adds traditional, refined serif text. Stencilia earns its keep big and brief.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-slabo-13px: Chunky, structural, and a bit showy. Make Stencilia small and its striking display character fades, while Slabo 13px, a bookish serif with large open counters, holds up fine at body size.
